instruction.text: We have travelled back in time to the 1920s. Select the drum kit to find out what type of music the band is playing.

atoms.text: The band is playing jazz! This type of music was first played by African-American communities in New Orleans, a city in the south of the USA.

instruction.text: Match the correct names to the musical instruments.

feedback.finish: These four instruments are often used in jazz music. The piano and guitar are also very popular.

atoms.a: How do you think the British public first listened to jazz?

feedback.end: Jazz was most commonly listened to with large, flat discs called records. Records were placed onto a gramophone, and music would play as the disc spun.
Improvisation is when musicians make up music on the spot. A popular way of improvising in jazz is known as call and response.

instruction.text: Select the trumpet player to hear a call and response.

atoms.text: Call and response in jazz comes from West African musical traditions. It involves one musician playing a phrase, and another responding to it.

instruction.text: Draw a line between New Orleans and London to find out how jazz arrived in Britain.

feedback.end: From the 1920s, American jazz musicians began travelling to Britain to tour and record here.

instruction.text: You are speaking to the famous American jazz musician Louis Armstrong. Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: When did you start playing ((++music football))?
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-0.5st'>When did you start playing music?</prosody>

atoms.b: As a boy, I was inspired by other jazz artists in New Orleans and began to play in different ((++bands teams)).
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-2st'>As a boy, I was inspired by other jazz artists in New Orleans and began to play in different bands.</prosody>
ssml: <prosody pitch = '-0.5st'>What instruments did you play?</prosody>

atoms.b: I liked to ((++play sing)) the trumpet and the cornet, which is a smaller brass instrument.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-2st'>I liked to play the trumpet and the cornet, which is a smaller brass instrument.</prosody>

atoms.b: When did you first ((++travel swim)) to Britain?
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-0.5st'>When did you first travel to Britain?</prosody>

atoms.b: I went on tour to ((++Britain Japan)) in 1932, but lots of people there didn’t want to listen to my music because of the colour of my skin.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-2st'>I went on tour to Britain in 1932, but lots of people there  didn’t want to listen to my music because of the colour of my skin.</prosody>

atoms.b: As a black artist, it was harder to be recognised for my talent, but eventually the popularity of my ((++music fashion)) and jazz took over, so people had to take it seriously.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-2st'> As a black artist, it was harder to be recognised for my talent, but eventually the popularity of my music and jazz took over, so people had to take it seriously.</prosody>

feedback.finish: Jazz has continued to be very popular in the UK until today! Young musicians are still being inspired by this genre.
